prompt: Who was the Argentinian president who resigned from the position the same year the José Martín Olaeta Stadium was inaugurated?
answer: The president was **Pedro Pablo Ramírez**, Argentina’s de facto president, who resigned in **February 1944**, the same year the José Martín Olaeta Stadium was inaugurated.
